channel.title: Automating the Boring Parts
channel.description: A non-engineer's log of building income streams with Claude Code

item.title: Claude Code Filled In My KDP Listings. It Still Needed Me Twice
item.description: Claude Code, using Claude in Chrome, filled in KDP listings for two of my ebooks and stopped before Publish. The weekly cap, AI disclosure, and my two steps.

item.title: I Built Tools to Sell Digital Products and Listed Zero
item.description: In June, Claude Code built me a tool and a 90-day plan for selling digital products. Five months later: zero listed, zero sales. Where it stalled, and why.

item.title: My Automated Blog Went 99 Days Without a Post. Nothing Broke.
item.description: Three posts in July, then 99 days of silence. Nothing failed; the queue was empty. How I made the refill a Claude Code skill, and what an AI reviewer found.

item.title: I Generated 8 Books in One Day. Listing Them Was the Hard Part.
item.description: Eight manuscripts in one day. Five months later, three are on sale and five aren't. What I automated, what I left to myself, and what I'd change.

item.title: Claude Code vs ChatGPT: What It Does That a Chat Window Can't
item.description: Not a benchmark. Four things I watched Claude Code do in the folders behind this blog and my books, and the parts where it left the work, and the stalls, to me.

item.title: A $0 Self-Updating Blog on GitHub Pages: The Whole Setup
item.description: How this site runs for $0 on GitHub Pages: a Python generator, a reviewed-only queue, and a scheduled publisher. Real costs, the setup steps, and what broke.
